'''Aria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Near-Human]] who in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. She wanted to work in the [[Grande Game]] casino. To impress the owner, [[Kelko]], Aria showed him her skills as a waiter, cashier and doorperson. Kelko instead believed that she was working for free, and decided not to hire her and enjoy her presence.<ref name="Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref>
